description: Provision a Google Cloud Identityplatform IdentityPlatformTenantOAuthIDPConfig via Config Connector. Fields mirror the identityplatform.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 IdentityPlatformTenantOAuthIDPConfig spec.

clientId.description: The client id of an OAuth client.

clientSecret.description: The client secret of the OAuth client, to enable OIDC code flow. Set exactly one of `value` (a literal) or `valueFrom` (a reference to a Secret key).

value.description: Value of the field. Cannot be used if 'valueFrom' is specified.

valueFrom.description: Source for the field's value. Cannot be used if 'value' is specified.

secretKeyRef.description: Reference to a value with the given key in the given Secret in the resource's namespace.

key.description: Key that identifies the value to be extracted.

name.description: Name of the Secret to extract a value from.

displayName.description: The config's display name set by developers.

enabled.description: True if allows the user to sign in with the provider.

issuer.description: For OIDC Idps, the issuer identifier.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

responseType.description: The multiple response type to request for in the OAuth authorization flow. This can possibly be a combination of set bits (e.g.: {id\_token, token}).

code.description: If true, authorization code is returned from IdP's authorization endpoint.

idToken.description: If true, ID token is returned from IdP's authorization endpoint.

token.description: If true, access token is returned from IdP's authorization endpoint.

tenantRef.description: Immutable. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description:
The tenant for the resource

Allowed value: The Google Cloud resource name of an `IdentityPlatformTenant` resource (format: `projects/{{project}}/tenants/{{name}}`).

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/
